name: Venomancer: the login stream hides weapons on the Burrow model
contract: Burrow (806154) applies 806152, a transform to display 15435 on model 2206 (InvisibleMan.mdx).
The client's CreatureModelData row 2206 has flags 0x3; without flag 0x10 the client draws the weapons above the burrow, which Ascension's live client does not.
The login patch stream sends model rows whose server values differ from the client's copy as SMSG_PATCH_CREATURE_MODEL_DATA (0x0974): 28 dwords, then the sized model name.
Row 2206 is sent once with flags 0x13. Row 5860, which the server holds unchanged, is not sent.
Socketless packet construction does not establish how the client renders the model.

steps.label: The login stream sends model row 2206 once
Row 2206 keeps the client's collision width 0.6111
Row 2206 carries the InvisibleMan model name
An unchanged model row is not streamed
